Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.
Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.
Boxing robot Battling Maxo breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.
Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.
An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.
Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.
A bored, wealthy businessman gets a chance to go back in time and start over, armed with all the knowledge he's acquired.
The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he wins against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.
Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.
While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.
Using the power of mind over matter, Archibald Beechcroft remakes the world to his own specifications.

After successfully stealing a gold shipment, a group of criminals and their scientist accomplice put themselves in suspended animation in a remote desert cave. When they awaken decades later, complications ensue when their truck is destroyed.
Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.
Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.
Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policeman try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.
Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her, and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…
Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.
An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.
A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!
Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.
On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.
